purpose: Research priors and algorithmic ideas for lottery prediction, coverage optimization, anti-overfit validation and combinatorial ticket design.

sources.title: Applying constraint programming to minimal lottery designs
sources.integration: Use CP/covering-design logic to optimize finite ticket portfolios after a candidate pool has been produced.

sources.title: Tackling the 6/49 Lottery and Debunking Common Myths with Probabilistic Methods and Combinatorial Designs
sources.integration: Benchmark model-restricted pools against random baselines; do not assume hot/cold restrictions improve jackpot probability; exploit covering design only as portfolio engineering.

sources.title: On the Lottery Problem: Tracing Stefan Mandel's Combinatorial Condensation
sources.integration: Treat condensation as coverage compression, not prediction; quantify residual miss probability and cost before any portfolio is considered.

sources.title: Predicting Winning Lottery Numbers
sources.integration: Implement only as a separately frozen Bayesian family and compare to uniform/random calibration; never promote from in-sample fit alone.

sources.title: Combinatorial Designs: Constructions and Analysis
sources.integration: Reference library for deterministic and algebraic coverage constructions.
